from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/research/510300_dr007_amount_shared_local_source_probe_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
protocol={
 "study_id":"510300_DR007_AMOUNT_SHARED_LOCAL_SOURCE_PROBE_V1",
 "experiment_id":"E58","registered_at":stamp,
 "hypothesis":"共享研究线2026-10-02新保存的DR007来源可能保留同证券同品种的原成交额；金额若实际存在，才有新的数量信息源可供单独登记，不把新利率处理当成交额。",
 "already_observed_metadata":"TECH.R118协议及source_summary只有DR007.IB/DR007/weight、2905原行、2015-01-05至2026-08-14和原2823股票日历；尚未读其实际数据源schema或原金额值。",
 "bounded_inspection":{"root":"reports/research/510300_point_funding_optional_correction_v1","root_files":["verification.json","研究结果与下一步.md"],"root_file_names":True,"metadata_parent_hops_max":2,"direct_schema_inspections_max":4,"network_requests":0,"credential_config_reads":0,"secret_output":False},
 "target_identity":{"ts_code":"DR007.IB","repo_maturity":"DR007","field":"amount","provider_documented_unit":"万元","other_official_field":"trdVol为另一原源亿元，不混同不同日期金额"},
 "no_inference":"weight及其变换不能推出amount；不从另一券种、R007或成交比例代替；不得推测父文件、开新网络、申请账户、使用到期凭据或重试旧E33。",
 "decision":"只有实际原对象明确保存amount、日期、同品种身份及计量单位才报告金额存在；只有新源完整原成员支持与金额公开时钟另登记后才可能模型准入。仅schema发现不准入模型。",
 "if_missing":"保留E33无有效访问事实；报告新的本地线索已穷尽，此单项仍未检验，不把金额经济假设判为无效。",
 "economic_result_reads":0,"new_fits":0,"new_labels":0,"full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "first_vintage_verified":False,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,
 "orders_authorized":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET"
}
(out/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
base=root/protocol["bounded_inspection"]["root"]
record={"at":stamp,"source_root":str(base),"names":sorted(p.name for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_file()),"metadata":[]}
for name in protocol["bounded_inspection"]["root_files"]:
 p=base/name
 record["metadata"].append({"path":str(p.relative_to(root)),"exists":p.exists(),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None,"text":p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") if p.exists() else None})
(out/"第一层有限原导航.json").write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"protocol":str(out/"protocol.json"),"inspection":record},ensure_ascii=False))
